question: Related Questions Q. We are five partners and four of us are investing money for a business and one will monitor and maintain liason and work physically too. The profit will be equally distributed among us. Our business is mainly with small vehicles and we will give them to a garrege owner who will arrange drivers and security of the vehicles from stealing. The garrege owner will pay us a certain rent for every vehicle everyday and he will also take a certain amount from every vehicle everyday from the drivers. We the investors will manage money to repair the vehicles when necessary. My question, is our income halal in this condition? 1503 views Q. AM I REQUIRED TO PAY THE ARREAS AS DEMANDE BY MR. AZHARUDDIN? 1794 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 3932 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Is it allowed to use credit cards if i am not paying any intrest. also i have credit card machine which i Ineeded to keep for my customers who are coming from abroad. please advice. Question: salaamo alaikum respctd muftisaab, is it allowed to use credit cards if i am not paying any intrest. also i have credit card machine which i needed to keep for my customers who are coming from abroad. please advice jazakallah khair Answer ID: 3932 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 846/638=H) Credit card is allowable as far as it is free from interest based transactions. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
